brief:
Pilot card · Jund · Tier 2 · Proxy · DBZA deck 2
 Perfecter Cell
 Kresh the Bloodbraided
 KRESH THE BLOODBRAIDED
 B R G 
 printed: Perfecter Cell · Human Warrior · MV 5
 Whenever another creature dies , you may put X +1/+1 counters on Kresh, where X is that creature's power .
 Anyone's creature, any cause. Power as it was the instant it died.
 3/3 
 ↻ Every turn — the removal is the engine
 1
 Kill something
 At instant speed, on their turn: Terminate, Infernal Grasp, Bitter Triumph, Putrefy, Bedevil, Tribute to Hunger . Biggest power first — it's the most food.
 2
 Take every trigger
 Kresh grows. Harvester draws (nontoken). Wurm drains 2. Toshiro recasts an instant — you pay for it . Sangromancer: 3 life.
 3
 Build the table
 Rocks, then engines: Arena, Black Market Connections, Guardian Project . Great Henge costs {X} less — X is Kresh's power.
 4
 Suit him up
 Cloak (unblockable), Shadowspear (trample), Embercleave (double strike, trample). Leave {1}{G} up for Heroic Intervention.
 5
 Punch through
 He's midrange, not a clock. Swing into a standing board once he's big enough that blocks just feed him.
 Best food first: 
 Biggest power — most counters › 
 Nontoken — Harvester draws › 
 Opponent's — Wurm, Toshiro, Glissa fire › 
 Tokens last 
 Rules that decide games
 - Any death, anyone's, any cause. Their bad block, their sacrifice, another player's removal: all food. The thesis picks the 99; it doesn't narrow the trigger.
 - Last known power. Shrunk before it died, Kresh gets the shrunk number. Wurm's −2/−2 and Massacre Girl's wither both do this — a 3/2 dying to Wurm feeds 1. Kill big things with a clean kill spell.
 - Exile isn't dying. King Macar exiles: no counters, no Harvester card.
 - Kresh dies in the same wrath → zero counters. The triggers happen with nothing to put them on. Protect first, then wrath : Heroic Intervention (indestructible beats Damnation), then cast it. Mizzium Mortars overload is one-sided — he's never in it.
 - No commander damage at this table. Kresh kills through life totals like any creature.
 Mulligan
 3+ lands and a turn 1–3 play: keep.
 A rock, cheap removal, Sakura-Tribe Elder, Toshiro. Ship two-landers leaning on the top end — ten cards cost 6+. Don't keep for Kresh: a 5-drop 3/3 does nothing alone.
 Traps
 - Toshiro isn't free. You pay the instant's cost again, and it's exiled after. Opponents' creatures only.
 - Halana and Alena give counters equal to their own power (2), not the target's, plus haste.
 - Dirge Bat can't mutate onto Kresh — he's a Human, and so is Toshiro. Mutate onto a Hydra or Harvester to fire the kill.
 - Whispersilk Cloak gives shroud — Snakeskin Veil can't target him after. Heroic Intervention still works.
 - Recast tax: +{2} each time. It bit game 1. Count it before you tap out.
 - Liliana's −2 targets one player , not each. Witch-king's attack makes the defender sacrifice their least -power creature — nobody picks.
 How you win — one big swing
 Kill
 spot removal, edicts, wraths
 › 
 Grow
 +power of every death
 › 
 Suit up
 Cloak · Spear · Cleave
 › 
 = lethal
 from one creature, through a full board
 ×2 EMBERCLEAVE 
 Eat a 12-power fatty and Kresh is 15/15. Embercleave makes that 32 trample . Kalonian Hydra attacking alongside doubles every counter on Kresh before damage.
 Hold the protection mana. Game 1: turn 7, couldn't hold up {1}{G} for Heroic Intervention, and Kresh connected once all game. The turn you suit him up is the turn to leave it open.
 Other ways it ends: Villainous Wrath (target opponent loses life per creature, then wipe), Massacre Wurm's 2-per-death drain, Garruk's −6 emblem, Ulamog (cast trigger destroys a permanent, annihilator 4), Etali.
 What the two games said
 Game 1 · pod · lost
 Kresh turn 5, connected once. Couldn't hold up Intervention turn 7, came up a mana short on the recast. Lost to Bryce, to an unblocked attacker. Felt slow on 37 lands + 9 ramp.
 Game 2 · 1v1 Jay · won
 The removal suite carried it — 32 damage to Jay. Kresh never got to flex his size. Read as reps, not build.
 Changed since (wave 7)
 Card draw went from 3–4 to 10: Harvester of Souls, Phyrexian Arena, Black Market Connections, Painful Truths, Guardian Project, The Great Henge, Ohran Frostfang in. Swiftfoot Boots, Hero's Downfall, Rakdos Charm, Rimescale Dragon out. This list hasn't played a game yet.
 Easy to forget
 - Kogla and Yidaro from hand: {2}{R}{G}, discard it — destroy an artifact or enchantment, shuffle it back, draw. Instant speed.
 - Massacre Wurm's drain stays on after the −2/−2: every opponent creature that dies later costs its owner 2.
 - Managorger Hydra grows off every spell anyone casts, not deaths.
 Before the
first shuffle
 Proxies — the villain name is up top, the real card is underneath. Ask what anything does. 
 PLAYTEST-CROSSREF is the backup if the print's too small.
